correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed exposed-vertex classification for the unscaled edge-diamond Minkowski sum over C_n, n>=5. Generic supporting functionals choose the larger absolute endpoint on each edge; strict increase along orientations excludes the two uniform directed cycles. Every nonconstant cyclic binary word realizes an acyclic orientation, and b_i-b_{i-1} determines indegrees uniquely (the only other constant-difference pair is the excluded all-zero/all-one pair). Exactly 2k transitions imply k zero, k double, n-2k single coordinates, squared norm n+2k; 2*binom(n,2k) words times 2^(n-k) independent signs gives N_{n,k}=2^(n-k+1)binom(n,2k). Max k=floor(n/2) gives squared radius n+2floor(n/2); symmetry and strict convexity give unique center, outer contacts and antipodal diameter pairs. Independent low-order counts n=5: (320,80), n=6:(960,480,16) corroborated, not used to prove infinite n.
